faq.description: Everything you need to know about working with KEDJORA. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact our team.
faq.contactTeam: Our team is ready to help answer your specific questions.

timeline.question: How long does a project take?
timeline.answer: Project duration varies depending on complexity. A simple landing page can be completed in 7-14 days, multi-page websites in 2-4 weeks, and mobile apps in 1-3 months. We'll provide a detailed timeline after discussing your requirements.

pricing.question: How does the payment system work?
pricing.answer: We use a staged payment system: 50% upfront as a deposit, and 50% upon project completion. For larger projects, payments can be divided into multiple milestones.

revision.question: Is there a limit on revisions?
revision.answer: Each package has a different number of revisions. Starter package includes 2 revisions, Professional 5 revisions, and Enterprise unlimited revisions. Revisions beyond the quota will incur additional charges.

support.question: What about support after project completion?
support.answer: We provide free support according to the selected package (1-3 months). After the support period ends, you can subscribe to monthly maintenance or contact us for fixes at a separate cost.

payment.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept bank transfers (BCA, Mandiri, BNI), e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, Dana), and for international clients, PayPal or Wise.

origin.title: The Origin
origin.paragraph1: KEDJORA (derived from "Kediri Jorah") started as a small collective of passionate developers in East Java. "Jorah" implies excellence and being a champion—a spirit we instill in every line of code we write.
origin.paragraph2: We saw a gap in the industry: agencies too focused on design without substance, or too technical without soul. We were determined to bridge that gap.
origin.paragraph3: Today, we help businesses worldwide navigate the complex digital landscape, transforming vague ideas into powerful, scalable, and beautiful products.
